title_zh: 以停顿替代舞台击打动作

scenario.label_zh: 以克制表演替代真实击打的排练安排
scenario.goal_zh: 澄清角色愤怒的触发点并约定采用无接触表演

context_zh: 演员 Cora 与导演 Felix 排练虚构短剧，讨论安全的表演选择，不描述伤人技术。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: The script calls for a punch here, but I don't want any actual contact.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: Nor do I. The scene is about rage, not about making an impact look real.

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: What could provoke that reaction so suddenly?

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: The character has just read a letter exposing a lie. Let the audience see you trying to hold back.

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: So the restraint is part of the moment, rather than a weaker version of it?

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: Exactly. Pause, lower your hand, and let the letter fall.

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: I can do that. Shall we try it without the other actor standing close to me?

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: Yes. We'll rehearse the reaction on its own first.
